test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A $ B' means 'A is the mother of B',

'A # B' means 'A is the father of B',

'A ! B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A @ B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 **A is**
 
 

 **Symbol**
 $
 #
 !
 @
 *
 >
 %
 ^
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Mother
 Father
 Sister
 Brother
 Wife
 Husband
 Father-in-law
 Mother-in-law
 
 

 **to B**
 
 

Now, 

a) 'P > Q $ R > S ! T' → P is the husband of Q who is the mother of R who is the husband of S who is the sister of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce2ddb54776b7d3bc8a1dae51a42caf6aca4b390a184b0408d4e78d2631b0f35.png] 

b) 'U # T' → U is the father of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91074dfb214fe9720d0701f4b3073cf1e7abc125463ee36094285f4d3113fc95.png] 

c) 'R # A' → R is the father of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36e099e7d49b1bfaf9252a5cd72553a843e6b82a7f9be01f7eb4803528174f90.png] 

So, U is the maternal grandfather or mother's father of A.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
